title: Simulation package: Configuration-dependent value of uncertainty-aware MPC for behind-the-meter batteries in food processing
description:
Code, data and results of a closed-loop simulation study comparing deterministic MPC, MPC with a tuned constant SoC back-off and an uncertainty-aware MPC for a behind-the-meter battery in three configurations (renewable buffer, self-consumption, set-point). The cell is driven by one year of anonymised load of a Hungarian meat-processing plant, Hungarian day-ahead prices (ENTSO-E) and Gaussian-process renewable forecasts from Open-Meteo weather data.

Contents: the controller code in the version used, the experiment pipelines (equal-budget multi-objective Bayesian tuning, pre-registered point selection and one-shot final test, decision map, monthly walk-forward winter test with re-trained forecasts), all result files including the pre-registration records and run logs, and the scripts that generate every table, number and figure of the paper.

Version 1.1.0 adds the analyses of the revision: sensitivity runs, calibration and tail diagnostics, pre-registered tests of the energy-deficit ratio (with their time-stamped records), prospective back-off sizing, tariff variants, seasonal re-selection and a benchmark of the ratio against storage-sizing indicators.
